_about: Condition criteria (brain metastases, HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, prior malignancy, QTc), hand-labelled from the protocol's own eligibility text (the registry summary where it disagrees is not the label). Policy criteria are scored as a permissiveness level: brain_mets 0 = any brain metastases excluded, 1 = treated/stable allowed, 2 = untreated asymptomatic also allowed; hiv 0 = HIV excluded, 1 = controlled HIV allowed; hbv 0 = chronic or known HBsAg-positive excluded, 1 = only active infection excluded; hcv 0 = HCV antibody-positive excluded, 1 = only active (RNA-positive) infection excluded. prior_malignancy is the disease-free interval in years required for another cancer; qtc is the allowed QTc in ms. absent = the eligibility text states no such criterion (an extracted value counts as a false positive). ambiguous = the text can be read two ways; not scored. Labeller: TrialForge developer (single annotator, not independently adjudicated). split: dev for every protocol: these rules were written and tuned on these same 19 protocols, so the score measures fit to the development set, not accuracy on unseen protocols.

protocols.name: CheckMate 9LA
protocols.note: Protocol p. 43: previous malignancies excluded unless complete remission at least 2 years before first treatment; the registry text has no such item. This protocol version states no HIV or hepatitis criterion.

ambiguous.hcv: Excludes a positive test for 'hepatitis C virus ribonucleic acid (HCV antibody)': RNA (level 1) and antibody (level 0) are both named.

protocols.name: KEYNOTE-042
protocols.note: No prior malignancy unless curative therapy with no recurrence for 5 years since its start: a 5-year interval, not a lifetime exclusion.

protocols.name: CASPIAN (SCLC)
protocols.note: Protocol pp. 55 and 58: HBsAg-positive excluded, HCV antibody-positive eligible if PCR-negative, another primary malignancy allowed after 5 years disease-free. The registry summary says only 'Active infection including tuberculosis, HIV, hepatitis B anc C'.
